custodian: Independent person/process designated by user before confirmation preparation
required_before_execution: User acceptance of bounded runner qualification
Frozen treatment, model, scorer, protocol and analysis revisions
Independent full confirmation input manifest, N and coverage or sampling basis
Per-file hashes and root manifest hash; separation from disclosed development/engineering inputs
No outcome-based condition selection or return of confirmation outputs to development
User review of N, coverage, hashes and total resource budget

budget_rule.N_null_meaning: Confirmation gate not ready; never permission to execute or waive confirmation

retention: Preserve all failed, incomplete and noncompliant rows; no favorable rerun selection
contamination_rule: Once any confirmation output is seen, revision/retry must disclose contamination; reused cases cannot be called unseen
